findings.description: The separator condition was inverted when moving the join into get_help_spec: it now uses "; " when any_prefix_is_slash is false and " / " when it is true, the opposite of the original code.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any option with no slash prefix, such as --verbose with -v, reaches this join. Originally it rendered as "-v / --verbose"; with the inverted condition it renders as "-v; --verbose". Options that do use slash prefixes get the wrong separator too. Mechanism: the ternary branches are swapped relative to the original `if any_prefix_is_slash else`. Impact: every option's help left column in the rendered --help output changes, which is a user-visible regression.
